ad_info.structure_source: library format F33 (Antes y después 3D con descuento en estrella, winning structure mv-01)
ad_info.reference_style: 3D animated (Pixar-like) before/after supplement ad with campaign ribbon, benefit icons, offer star and CTA button
ad_info.angle_used: Beneficio sin sacrificio: more curves without surgery

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep panels), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (soft background and light cards), white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary for this variation: soft lilac sky tint #F3D9F0 in the background gradient.
global_identity.visual_style: High-end 3D animated character render (Pixar-like), glossy and friendly, with the real bottle photoreal and sharp.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Warm, hopeful and fun; soft fuchsia glow on the branded elements.
global_identity.graphic_language: Ribbon banner, diagonal color panel, cream rounded card with thin line icons separated by thin dividers, multi-point starburst, pill button with round arrow, curved arrow between before and after.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in very heavy italic geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black Italic look), uppercase; icon labels, strip and button in rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins Bold look), uppercase.

creative_objective: Stop the scroll of Colombian women who want more curves but are scared of surgery: show the same 3D woman going from worried (loose jeans at the back) to happy (jeans that fit, bottle in hand), and close with the 3-month treatment, pay-on-delivery and the INVIMA registration, keeping the exact F33 structure.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the fuchsia ribbon and the before/after characters, 2) the headline on the plum panel, 3) the big bottle, 4) the offer starburst and the button, 5) the icons and the trust strip.
art_direction.composition_style: Top 15%: ribbon banner centered. Middle 50%: split before/after with a thin light vertical line in the center and a curved arrow from left to right. Bottom 35%: diagonal plum panel on the left with headline, icon card and trust strip; big bottle center-bottom overlapping everything; starburst and button on the right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Tight, dense but organized commercial layout; every block aligned to its zone; the bottle overlaps the panel edge to create depth.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft studio light on the 3D characters, gentle rim light, the bottle in front with a crisp shadow and a soft fuchsia glow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top center: a glossy fuchsia ribbon banner with white text and a small tag shape at its right end (no brand logo above it; that space stays as background). Center: before (left) and after (right) of the same 3D woman, separated by a thin light vertical line, with a curved bubblegum-pink arrow from left to right. Bottom-left: a diagonal dark plum panel with a 3-line headline, below it a pale blush card with 4 line icons and labels, and below it a dark plum pill strip with 2 trust items. Bottom-center: the real bottle, large, in front. Bottom-right: a fuchsia multi-point starburst with the offer, and under it a bubblegum-pink pill button with a round plum arrow.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Campaign hook that frames the ad
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Glossy fuchsia ribbon with a small tag at the right end, text about the 3-month natural plan instead of a seasonal campaign
3D woman seen three-quarters from behind, looking back over her shoulder with a worried face, wearing a plain white t-shirt and light blue jeans that hang loose and baggy at the back

Same 3D woman on another day, fuchsia crop top, same pose family but more confident, smiling over her shoulder, the jeans now fit snugly with a rounder, fuller shape at the back; she holds a small version of the real bottle in her hand

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Directs the eye from problem to result
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Curved bubblegum-pink arrow and a thin light vertical divider line
Dark plum diagonal panel, 3-line white heavy italic uppercase headline, last line in bubblegum pink
Pale blush rounded card with 4 plum line icons (crossed-out syringe, two capsules, leaf, sparkle drop) and short uppercase labels, separated by thin vertical dividers
Dark plum pill: shield icon + registration text | hand-with-cash icon + pay on delivery text, separated by a thin divider
The real bottle from the attached photo, large, upright, sharp
Fuchsia multi-point starburst with a thin white border: a giant white 'X3' and below it the treatment text; no percentage
Bubblegum-pink wide pill with dark plum text and a round dark plum circle with a white chevron arrow

forbidden_additions: Brand logo or brand name text above the ribbon
Percentage discount, prices or crossed-out prices
Black Friday or any seasonal campaign text
Rating stars, testimonials or customer counts
Glowing organs, x-ray or any medical detail on the body

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 supplement ad in high-end 3D animated style (Pixar-like characters), on a soft gradient background from pale blush pink #FBE3EE to a light lilac #F3D9F0. TOP 15%: a glossy hot-fuchsia #E6177F ribbon banner centered, with a soft glow and a small tag shape hanging at its right end, carrying the white text 'PLAN NATURAL DE 3 MESES'; nothing above it, just background. MIDDLE 50%: a before/after split with a thin light vertical line in the exact center. LEFT (before): a friendly 3D Latina woman in her early thirties, wavy dark brown hair in a loose bun, seen three-quarters from behind and looking back over her shoulder with a worried, insecure face; she wears a plain white t-shirt and light blue jeans that hang loose, flat and baggy at the back. RIGHT (after): the same woman on another day, wearing a fuchsia crop top and the same jeans, now fitting snugly with a rounder, fuller and lifted shape at the back, standing confident and smiling warmly over her shoulder, holding in one hand a small copy of the exact product bottle. A curved bubblegum-pink #FF8CC0 arrow goes from the before to the after. Tasteful, non-explicit, no medical details. BOTTOM 35%: on the left, a diagonal dark plum #2B1226 panel holding the 3-line headline in heavy white italic uppercase, with the last line in bubblegum pink; under it a pale blush rounded card with 4 plum thin-line icons (a syringe with a cross-out line, two capsules, a leaf, a sparkle drop) each with a short uppercase label, separated by thin vertical dividers; under the card, a dark plum pill strip with a shield icon and the registration text, a thin divider, and a hand-with-cash icon with the payment text. In the bottom center, overlapping the panel edge and in front of everything, the large real product bottle, upright and razor sharp: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; black label with the small pink VITALABH emblem, the huge bold white word 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', the small line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra', a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)'. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it; keep its proportions, colors and label layout. On the right, a hot-fuchsia multi-point starburst with a thin white border showing a giant white 'X3' and the treatment text below it; under the starburst a wide bubblegum-pink pill button with dark plum text and a round dark plum circle with a white chevron. Soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, crisp edges, everything readable on a phone. Do not add any brand logo, price, percentage, free-shipping text, guarantee, stars or extra text.

mandatory_visual_elements: Glossy fuchsia ribbon banner with a small tag at the right end
Same 3D woman in before (worried, loose jeans at the back, white t-shirt) and after (smiling, fitted jeans, fuchsia crop top, holding the bottle)
Thin vertical divider line and curved bubblegum-pink arrow between before and after
Pale blush card with 4 thin-line icons and dividers
Dark plum trust strip with shield and hand-with-cash icons
Large real product bottle in the bottom center, identical to the attached photo
Bubblegum-pink pill button with round plum arrow circle
final_generation_exclusions: No brand logo or brand name above the ribbon; no percentage discount, prices or crossed-out prices; no free shipping, guarantee, stars or testimonials.
No organs, x-ray, glowing body parts or any medical detail; no nudity; no pointing at body flaws with marks or labels.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
